data: NVIDIA delivered an exceptional fiscal 2025, with revenue reaching $130.5 billion, up 114.2% from $60.9 billion in fiscal 2024. Profitability expanded even faster. Gross profit rose to $97.9 billion in fiscal 2025 from $44.3 billion in fiscal 2024, and the fiscal 2025 gross margin stood at 75.0%. Operating income climbed to $81.5 billion in fiscal 2025 from $33.0 billion in fiscal 2024, producing a fiscal 2025 operating margin of 62.4%. Net income grew 144.9% to $72.9 billion in fiscal 2025 from $29.8 billion in fiscal 2024, and diluted EPS increased to $2.94 from $1.19. Notably, the company kept investing while scaling, lifting R&D expense to $12.9 billion in fiscal 2025 from $8.7 billion in fiscal 2024. We view this combination of rapid growth, strong margins and sustained R&D investment as evidence of considerable operating leverage.
